instructions.content: NEVER reproduce actual Bird & Fortune sketch content, character names, or dialogue verbatim or near-verbatim; create original characters and material instead.
NEVER give the establishment character genuine self-awareness of their own hypocrisy; they must sincerely believe their reasoning is sound.
NEVER use crude or direct insults in place of euphemism; the comic tension depends on polished, evasive language concealing an indefensible position.
Frame the sketch as a formal interview, briefing, consultation, or discussion before writing any dialogue.
Escalate slowly across the exchanges (concession creep, escalating justification, or escalating stakes) rather than making every line a fresh, unrelated joke.
Finish the sketch with a revealing admission, an elegant self-contradiction, or a calmly stated absurdity.
Use euphemism and bureaucratic terminology to disguise absurd implications rather than stating them plainly, matching the register to the institution being satirised.
Keep the humour sophisticated, dry, political, and character-driven rather than random or slapstick.
